prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1457; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This recorded statement is for claim file purposes. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the location where the accident occurred.

A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan. The accident happened on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center entrance, late in the afternoon.

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened right before the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. Traffic had built up, so I was completely stopped. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit me from the rear. It was a firm hit, enough that my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not deploy. I was able to get out of the car on my own, but my neck was sore almost immediately.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes. A friend drove me to an urgent care clinic that evening. They examined my neck and back, took some X-rays, and diagnosed a neck strain. They gave me a muscle relaxant and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness after sitting at my desk for long periods, but I had never been treated for it.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Still stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week, and it's getting a little better, but I still can't sleep comfortably.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send over the medical bills and the repair estimate for my car as soon as I have them.
